default: Step in, traveler. Salt's up two coppers since Reapmoon, but the smile's still free. — *jingle, jingle.*
morning: *ties back the awning, copper steady on the post* — First foot at the stall is the lucky one, friend. Erris kept the road honest, the kettle's on at Bram's, and I've got new salt up from Cinder Reach. What'll it be?
midday: *jingle, jingle* — Market hour, lantern to lantern. Spice-tin's open, weight-stones are honest, and I'll throw in a story for the second copper. What's the satchel after?
evening: *folds back the third coat, warm light low across the counter* — Stall's slowing, sun's leaning, and I've still got bread that won't outlast the dark. By salt and signature, take the loaf for half — the road's hungrier than I am.
night: *jingle, jingle, softer* — Coppers are counted, traveler — except the one that doesn't count. Come back at dawn. Stall sleeps, but the kettle at Bram's doesn't.
after_first_quest_complete: *jingle, jingle, the brighter one* — Word reached the stall before the dust did. Lantern to lantern, friend — that's how good news travels. *slips a small wrapped wedge of southern honey across the counter* — On me. Don't argue. Erris likes her thanks said quick.
low_health_player: *comes out from behind the stall, satchel at her hip* — Sit, sit, sit. *eases you onto the stall-bench* — That's a road that's been walked too long today. There's hot bread in the cloth and a cup half-poured already — I was saving it for the next honest face. By salt and signature, no coppers tonight.
boss_alive: *pauses, hands still on the spice-tin* — The Whisperwood's been loud lately, friend. My southbound rider takes the long way round these moons — past the meadow, never the wood-edge. If you walk where my couriers won't, walk careful. *jingle, soft* — I'll keep a copper for Erris on your behalf.
boss_slain: *the jingle stops for a heartbeat — then comes back, quieter* — The road north of the wood is a road again, traveler. *lifts a small bronze coin from the till — fox-marked, family-marked — turns it once in her palm, sets it carefully back* — That's *mhairen* — what the satchel carries that isn't for sale. — Take a wedge of the southern honey. The next jar's already filling itself.
high_renown: *broad warm smile, both hands on the counter* — Bards came through with your name in the second verse, friend. Lantern to lantern, that's a long carry. *jingle, jingle* — *Ai-velin*, traveler. May the road that knows your name keep knowing it kindly.
stranger: *greets first, always* — Hello, hello! New face at the stall — that's an Erris kind of morning. The smile's free, the kettle's at Bram's, and I'm Mara — three coats, two satchels, one stall. What's the road brought you for?
longnight_vigil: *the stall is banked low, one candle steady in the front window* — Stall's closed tonight, traveler. Candle's mine. Bram's got the stew round — follow it if you're cold.
sunpetal_first_morning: *the stall is shuttered, the satchel hooked over her shoulder, an empty clay jar in her hand* — Walking out to the meadow, traveler. Won't be a moment. Watch the stall for me?

lore_notes._comment: Mood-keyed surface for Mara the Merchant. Tree shape mirrors data/dialogue/smith_edda.json and data/dialogue/innkeeper_bram.json exactly so NPC.gd can read all three through a single code path once Builder wires it. The seasonal slot is sunpetal_first_morning (Mara's loaded day — the southern-honey jar walked back to the meadow-edge stone for Lyra's round) instead of Edda's spring_first_warm_day or Bram's honeysong_eve. Backstory in lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md. The Withholding Ledger in that file is binding — see voice_rules below.
voice_rules: Greets first, always. Default opens with 'Step in' or 'Hello, hello' — Mara never makes the player speak first.

*jingle, jingle* as bodily verbal tic — used the way Edda uses *hammer-clang* and Bram uses *polishes mug*. Drop it from at most one of four warmed variants — only the warmest, where the closeness has earned the quieter bodily presence (per author note in lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md).

Drops Cinder Reach idioms in roughly every fifth sentence: *by salt and signature* (= I swear), *lantern to lantern* (= all the way). The southern register is the warming tell — Mara starts using these MORE with the player who has cleared one bounty, not less.
Soft southern lengthening of vowels in plain Common. No Goblin Cant. No Stone-Tongue.

Invokes Erris of the Two Roads at the lintel, the awning-post copper, and after every closed sale — under her breath, never loud. Never invokes the Hollow King by name. Never invokes Brigid (Edda's god) or Thiar (the hunters' god).

NEVER says Nessa. NEVER says Aelis. NEVER references the first letter, the second letter, or the contents of either. The two letters are *mhairen* and the withholding is the character — see lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md Withholding Ledger. Future writers must consult that ledger before extending Mara's tree.

Old Faerie words used sparingly. Mara-coded: *pendrel* (the third coin in the till that does not belong to the day's count) and *mhairen* (what the satchel carries that is not for sale). All other NPCs may use *ai-velin*; *pendrel* and *mhairen* are Mara-coded — other NPCs should use them only when speaking to or about her.
consequence_hooks: boss_slain is intentionally non-confirming about the smoke-cities, the Stone Crown, or anything that could surface Nessa or Aelis. The 'next jar's already filling itself' beat composes with the southern-honey round (lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md, lore/npcs/herbalist_lyra.md). If Builder ever wires the Sunpetal 1 / Reapmoon-last-day jar pulses into the world, this line reads even quieter on the same tick.

longnight_vigil composes with Edda's, Bram's, Maeve's, and Lyra's longnight_vigil lines. If all five fire on the same Longnight Vigil tick, the village's full Vigil ring plays itself across five thresholds: Edda doesn't look up; Bram brings the stew round; Maeve sets the bowl out for the Hollow King; Lyra carries the dreamleaf to the well; Mara holds the candle from the stall. No scripting required beyond mood-key resolution.

sunpetal_first_morning is the canonical seasonal pulse for Mara — the day she walks the full honey-jar back to the meadow-edge stone for the Hollow King's ants to find on Sunpetal 7. Composes with a future Polisher pass that places the empty jar at the stone during Reapmoon and the full jar during Sunpetal week one (per lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md hooks). The line MUST NOT name Lyra and MUST NOT name the Hollow King — both withholdings hold.

after_first_quest_complete is agnostic across which first quest completed — same convention as Edda's and Bram's. Safe to fire on whisperwood_cleansing OR pelt_for_lyra OR ears_for_mara turn-ins. The southern-honey wedge is a small flavor-only handoff and not a quest item.

low_health_player is the second-most actively caring line in the village after Bram's. Mara comes OUT from behind the stall — the only mood-key in her tree where she leaves the counter. She does not take Bram's bowl-and-bench round; she gives bread, a half-poured cup, and the bench. The two carings are designed to read as complementary, not competing.

boss_alive references the southbound rider taking the long way round — anchors to the lost_courier_pouch / Whisperwood-bandit-camp hook in lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md. Safe to fire even before bandits ship; reads as a cautious merchant in any state of the world.

high_renown's *Ai-velin* invocation is shared with Edda and Bram on the same key — by design. The three village elders blessing the player's road in the same Old Faerie word on the same renown threshold is the warmest co-fired beat in the tree.
future_keys_reserved: warmed_flag: 'ears_for_mara_complete' — once the four warmed_dialogue_variants ship per the integrator's tier-1 schema, the warming tell is Cinder-Reach idiomatic (more *lantern to lantern*, more *by salt and signature*). No letter content surfaces. No Nessa surfaces. The warming is the southern register, nothing more — see author note in lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md.

warmed_world_flag: 'first_pouch_returned' — reserved for the lost_courier_pouch fetch quest queued in lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md hooks. Reward is the *Yew-and-Lantern Brass Token*, hookable as a future apprenticeship invitation when Mara is ready to ask. Use sparingly — Mara is not yet ready to ask. The token is a flavor item; it is NOT a turn-in for the apprenticeship arc.

warmed_world_flag: 'water_stained_letter_kept' — explicitly NOT to be wired without re-reading lore/npcs/mara_merchant.md and lore/npcs/elder_maeve.md Withholding Ledgers. The turn-in is to Smith Edda, witnessed only by Maeve and Lyra, with Bram's pre-tuned reactive in the background. The letter is NEVER opened. The withholding is the kindness.
faction_pressure tier 3: not applicable — Mara has no faction stake. She is the second person in the village after Bram who treats every face as already-belonging.
